en.t: Libius Severus is declared emperor of the Western Roman Empire. The real power is in the hands of the magister militum Ricimer
en.s: In modern historiography, the Western Roman Empire was the Roman Empire's western provinces collectively during any period in which they were administered separately from the eastern provinces by a separate, independent imperial court. Particularly from AD 395 to 476, there were separate, coequal courts dividing the governance of the empire into western and eastern provinces with a distinct imperial succession in the separate courts.

zh.t: 利比乌斯·塞维鲁被宣布为西罗马帝国皇帝，实权掌握在军事统帅里西默手中
zh.s: 现代史学所称的西罗马帝国，是指罗马帝国西部诸省在与东部诸省分开治理、由独立的西部朝廷统辖期间的统称。尤其在公元395年至476年，帝国由彼此平等的东西两套朝廷分别治理，两地各有独立的皇位继承体系。

en.t: The Rashidun Caliphate defeats the Sasanian Empire at the Battle of al-Qādisiyyah in Iraq
en.s: The Battle of al-Qadisiyyah (Arabic: مَعْرَكَة ٱلْقَادِسِيَّة, romanized: Maʿrakat al-Qādisīya; Persian: نبرد قادسیه, romanized: Nabard-i Qādisiya) took place between the armies of the Rashidun Caliphate and the Sasanian Empire in November 636. It resulted in a decisive victory for the Rashidun army and is considered to be one of the most significant engagements of the Muslim conquest of Persia, and thereby of the early Muslim conquests as a whole.

zh.t: 拉希顿哈里发国在卡迪西亚战役中击败萨珊帝国
zh.s: 卡迪西亚战役（阿拉伯语：Maʿrakat al-Qādisīya；波斯语：Nabard-i Qādisiya）于636年11月在拉希顿哈里发国与萨珊帝国军队之间爆发。战役以拉希顿军队决定性胜利告终，被视为穆斯林征服波斯以及早期穆斯林征服过程中最重要的战役之一。

en.s: The Battle of Delebio was a battle of the Wars in Lombardy. It occurred on 18 and 19 November 1432, near Delebio, in the Valtellina. It was an aftermath of the occupation of Brescia and the Valle Camonica by the armies of the Republic of Venice, led by Francesco Bussone, Count of Carmagnola.

zh.s: 德莱比奥战役是伦巴第战争期间的一场战斗，于1432年11月18日至19日在瓦尔泰利纳的德莱比奥附近发生。威尼斯共和国军队占领布雷西亚和瓦尔卡莫尼卡后，引发了这场战斗。威尼斯军队由卡尔马尼奥拉伯爵弗朗切斯科·布索内率领。

en.s: The siege of Deventer was a siege of the city of Deventer in Overijssel during the Eighty Years' War. Troops of the States-General, under George van Lalaing, Count of Rennenberg, besieged Deventer from 3 August 1578. Rennenberg had overall command of the States forces, while Diederik Sonoy commanded the besieging troops. The city was defended by about 900 High German soldiers of the Polweiler regiment in royal service.

zh.s: 1578年八十年战争期间，荷兰总督辖区军队围攻上艾瑟尔省的代芬特市。雷嫩贝赫伯爵乔治·范·拉拉因统率总督辖区军队，迪德里克·索诺伊指挥围城部队。围城于1578年8月3日开始，城内由约900名为西班牙王室效力的普法尔茨军团高级德意志士兵守卫。

en.s: The siege of Fort Crozon or the siege of El Leon was a land and sea engagement that took place as part of Spain's Brittany campaign late in the French Wars of Religion and the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604). The siege was fought between 1 October and 19 November 1594 and was conducted by English and French troops against a Spanish fort constructed on the Crozon Peninsula near Brest.

zh.s: 克罗宗堡围城战又称埃尔莱昂围城战，是西班牙布列塔尼战役期间的一场陆海交战，发生于法国宗教战争后期及英西战争（1585年至1604年）期间。英国和法国军队于1594年10月1日至11月19日围攻布雷斯特附近克罗宗半岛上的一座西班牙堡垒。

en.t: The current Saint Peter's Basilica is consecrated in Rome, replacing an earlier basilica on the same site
en.s: The Papal Basilica of Saint Peter in the Vatican (Italian: Basilica Papale di San Pietro in Vaticano), or simply St. Peter's Basilica (Latin: Basilica Sancti Petri; Italian: Basilica di San Pietro [baˈziːlika di sam ˈpjɛːtro]), is a church of the Italian Renaissance located in Vatican City, an independent microstate enclaved within the city of Rome, Italy.

zh.t: 罗马现今的圣彼得大教堂举行祝圣仪式，取代同址较早建造的大教堂
zh.s: 梵蒂冈圣伯多禄宗座圣殿，简称圣伯多禄大殿（拉丁语：Basilica Sancti Petri；意大利语：Basilica di San Pietro），是一座意大利文艺复兴时期教堂，位于梵蒂冈城国。梵蒂冈城国是被意大利罗马市区包围的独立微型国家。

en.s: The Battle of Narva (Russian: Битва на Нарве; Swedish: Slaget vid Narva) on 19 November 1700 (30 November, N.S.) was an early battle in the Great Northern War. A Swedish relief army under Charles XII of Sweden defeated a Russian siege force three to four times its size. Before, Charles XII had forced Denmark-Norway to sign the Treaty of Travendal. Narva was not followed by further advances of the Swedish army into Russia, instead, Charles XII turned southward to expel August the Strong from Livonia and Poland-Lithuania. Tsar Peter the Great of Russia took Narva in a second battle in 1704.

zh.s: 1700年11月19日（新历11月30日），大北方战争初期，瑞典援军在瑞典国王卡尔十二世率领下击败了规模为其三至四倍的俄军围城部队。此前，卡尔十二世已迫使丹麦-挪威签署《特拉文达尔条约》。此后瑞典军队没有继续进军俄罗斯，卡尔十二世转而南下，将奥古斯特二世驱逐出利沃尼亚和波兰-立陶宛联邦。俄国沙皇彼得大帝于1704年在第二次战役中夺取纳尔瓦。

en.s: The 1781 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 19, 1781, in order to elect the Governor of Maryland. Incumbent Governor Thomas Sim Lee was easily re-elected by the Maryland General Assembly as he ran unopposed. The exact results of this election are unknown.

zh.s: 马里兰州于1781年11月19日举行州长选举。时任州长托马斯·西姆·李因没有对手，由马里兰州议会轻松连任。此次选举的具体结果不详。

en.s: The Treaty of Amity, Commerce, and Navigation, Between His Britannic Majesty and the United States of America, commonly known as the Jay Treaty, and also as Jay's Treaty, was a 1794 treaty between the United States and Great Britain that averted war, resolved issues remaining since the 1783 Treaty of Paris (which ended the American Revolutionary War), and facilitated ten years of peaceful trade between Americans and the British in the midst of the French Revolutionary Wars, which had begun in 1792.

zh.s: 《美利坚合众国与不列颠国王陛下友好、通商与航海条约》通常称为《杰伊条约》，也称杰伊的条约。这份1794年美国与英国签订的条约避免了战争，解决了《巴黎条约》（结束美国独立战争）后遗留的问题，并在1792年爆发的法国大革命战争期间，为英美贸易带来十年和平。

en.s: The Anglo-Russian invasion of Holland (or Anglo-Russian expedition to Holland, or Helder Expedition) was a military campaign from 27 August to 19 November 1799 during the War of the Second Coalition, in which an expeditionary force of British and Russian troops invaded the North Holland peninsula in the Batavian Republic. The campaign had two strategic objectives: to neutralize the Batavian fleet and to promote an uprising by followers of the former stadtholder William V against the Batavian government.

zh.s: 英俄入侵荷兰又称英俄远征荷兰或登海尔德远征，是第二次反法同盟战争期间的一场军事行动，于1799年8月27日至11月19日进行。英国和俄罗斯远征军入侵巴达维亚共和国的北荷兰半岛，目标是瓦解巴达维亚舰队，并推动前执政威廉五世的支持者起义反抗巴达维亚政府。

en.s: The Hanover Expedition, also known as the Weser Expedition, was a British invasion of the Electorate of Hanover during the Napoleonic Wars. Coordinated as part of an attack on France by the nations of the Third Coalition against Napoleon by William Pitt the Younger and Robert Stewart, Viscount Castlereagh, planning began for an invasion of French territories in July 1805.

zh.s: 汉诺威远征又称威悉河远征，是拿破仑战争期间英国对汉诺威选侯国发动的一次入侵。1805年7月，年轻的威廉·皮特和卡斯尔雷子爵罗伯特·斯图尔特开始策划入侵法国领土，将其作为第三次反法同盟各国共同对法攻击的一部分。

en.t: Finnish War: The Convention of Olkijoki in Raahe ends hostilities in Finland
en.s: The Finnish War was fought between the Kingdom of Sweden and the Russian Empire from 21 February 1808 to 17 September 1809 as part of the Napoleonic Wars. As a result of the war, the eastern third of Sweden was established as the autonomous Grand Duchy of Finland within the Russian Empire.

zh.t: 芬兰战争：拉赫的奥尔基约基公约结束芬兰境内敌对行动
zh.s: 芬兰战争是瑞典王国与俄罗斯帝国于1808年2月21日至1809年9月17日进行的战争，属于拿破仑战争的一部分。战后，瑞典东部约三分之一的领土被划为芬兰大公国，成为俄罗斯帝国内的自治地区。

en.s: The Battle of Ocaña was fought on 19 November 1809 between French forces under Marshal Nicolas Jean de Dieu Soult, Duke of Dalmatia and King Joseph Bonaparte and the Spanish army under Juan Carlos de Aréizaga, which suffered its greatest single defeat in the Peninsular War. General Juan Carlos de Aréizaga's Spanish army of 51,000 lost nearly 19,000 killed, wounded, prisoners and deserters, mostly due to the French use of their cavalry. The strategic consequences were also devastating, as it destroyed the only force capable of defending southern Spain; the area was overrun over the winter in the Andalusia campaign.

zh.s: 1809年11月19日，尼古拉·让·德迪厄·苏尔特元帅、达尔马提亚公爵和约瑟夫·波拿巴率领的法军，与胡安·卡洛斯·德·阿雷萨加率领的西班牙军队交战。西班牙军队遭遇半岛战争中单次战斗最大的惨败：5.1万人的部队有近1.9万人死伤、被俘或逃散，主要原因是法军使用骑兵。战役的战略后果同样严重，西班牙南部唯一能防守的军队被摧毁；冬季期间，法军在安达卢西亚战役中占领该地区。

en.s: The 1810 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 19, 1810, in order to elect the governor of Maryland. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor Edward Lloyd was re-elected by the Maryland General Assembly against Federalist candidates former governor John Eager Howard, Levin Winder and former United States senator Charles Carroll.

zh.s: 马里兰州于1810年11月19日举行州长选举。时任民主共和党州长爱德华·劳埃德由马里兰州议会选举连任，击败联邦党候选人、前州长约翰·伊格·霍华德、莱文·温德和前美国参议员查尔斯·卡罗尔。

en.s: The Battle of India Muerta took place between the Luso-Brazilian forces under the command of Sebastião Pinto de Araújo Correia against the artiguists led by Fructuoso Rivera in Rocha, present-day Uruguay. The battle lasted for four and a half hours and ended in a Luso-Brazilian victory.

zh.s: 葡巴联军在塞巴斯蒂昂·平托·德·阿劳若·科雷亚指挥下，与弗鲁克图索·里韦拉率领的阿蒂加斯派在今乌拉圭罗恰交战。战斗持续四个半小时，最终以葡巴联军获胜告终。

en.s: The University of Warsaw (Polish: Uniwersytet Warszawski; Latin: Universitas Varsoviensis) is a public research university in Warsaw, Poland. Established on November 19, 1816, it is the largest institution of higher learning in the country, offering 37 different fields of study as well as 100 specializations in humanities, technical, and natural sciences.

zh.s: 华沙大学是一所位于波兰华沙的公立研究型大学，成立于1816年11月19日，是波兰规模最大的高等教育机构。学校开设37个学科领域，并在人文、技术和自然科学领域提供100个专业方向。

en.t: The second Canadian railway line, the Montreal and Lachine Railroad, is opened
en.s: The Montreal and Lachine Railroad was Montreal's first railroad. The railroad was opened on November 19, 1847, with service between Bonaventure Station in Montreal and the St. Lawrence River in Lachine. Built to bypass the Lachine Rapids, it was 12 km long. The railway merged with the Lake St. Louis and Province Railroad in 1850 under the name Montreal and New York Railroad.

zh.t: 蒙特利尔与拉欣铁路开通
zh.s: 蒙特利尔与拉欣铁路是蒙特利尔的首条铁路，于1847年11月19日开通，连接蒙特利尔的博纳旺蒂尔车站和拉欣的圣劳伦斯河沿岸。铁路长12公里，修建目的是绕过拉欣急流。1850年，铁路与圣路易湖及省铁路合并，改名为蒙特利尔与纽约铁路。

en.s: Alfred Tennyson, 1st Baron Tennyson (; 6 August 1809 – 6 October 1892) was an English poet. He was Poet Laureate of the United Kingdom during much of Queen Victoria's reign. In 1829 he was awarded the Chancellor's Gold Medal at Cambridge for one of his first pieces, "Timbuktu". He published his first solo collection of poems, Poems, Chiefly Lyrical, in 1830.

zh.t: 阿尔弗雷德·丁尼生就任桂冠诗人
zh.s: 阿尔弗雷德·丁尼生，第一代丁尼生男爵（1809年8月6日—1892年10月6日）是英国诗人，在维多利亚女王统治的大部分时期担任英国桂冠诗人。1829年，他凭早期作品之一《廷巴克图》获得剑桥大学校长金奖。1830年，他出版首部个人诗集《主要为抒情诗》。

en.s: The Battle of Round Mountain was the first battle in the Trail of Blood on Ice campaign for the control of Indian Territory during the American Civil War that occurred on November 19, 1861. Its main purpose was to prevent Union supporters of the Creek Nation, led by Opothleyahola from fleeing Indian Territory to the protection of Union forces in Kansas.

zh.s: 圆山战役于1861年11月19日发生，是美国内战期间冰上血径战役中争夺印第安领地控制权的首场战斗。其主要目的是阻止由奥波特利亚霍拉率领的克里克族联邦支持者离开印第安领地，前往堪萨斯州寻求联邦军保护。

en.s: The Gettysburg Address is a dedication speech delivered by Abraham Lincoln, the 16th U.S. president, following the Battle of Gettysburg during the American Civil War. The speech has come to be viewed as one of the most famous, enduring, and historically significant speeches in American history.

zh.s: 葛底斯堡演说是美国第16任总统亚伯拉罕·林肯在美国内战期间、葛底斯堡战役之后发表的一篇致辞。它后来被视为美国历史上最著名、影响最深远且意义重大的演说之一。

en.s: Ren Zhu (Chinese: 任柱; died November 1867), born in Mengcheng Anhui, China was an eminent military leader of the Nien Rebellion who was known during his military tenure as the King of Lu (魯王). He led Nien (捻軍) forces to many military victories. Li Hongzhang praised Ren Zhu's ability to command hundreds of thousands of cavalry.

zh.s: 任柱（1867年11月去世）出生于中国安徽蒙城，是捻军的重要将领，军中称“鲁王”。他率领捻军取得过多场胜利。李鸿章称赞他善于统率数十万骑兵。

en.s: The Battle of San Francisco, also known as the Battle of Dolores, was a major battle in the Tarapacá Campaign of the War of the Pacific, fought on November 19, 1879, in the Peruvian department of Tarapacá. A Chilean army under Colonel Emilio Sotomayor had moved via Dolores rail road deep into the desert and was encamped at San Francisco Saltpeter Office, about 30 kilometers south east of the port of Pisagua.

zh.s: 圣弗朗西斯科战役又称多洛雷斯战役，是太平洋战争塔拉帕卡战役的一场重要战役，于1879年11月19日在秘鲁塔拉帕卡省发生。埃米利奥·索托马约尔上校率领的智利军队经由多洛雷斯铁路深入沙漠，并驻扎在圣弗朗西斯科硝石厂，距皮萨瓜港东南约30公里。

en.s: The Battle of Yu Oc (19 November 1884) was a French victory during the Sino-French War. The battle was fought to relieve the French garrison of Tuyên Quang, under siege by the T'ang Ching-sung's Yunnan Army and Liu Yongfu's Black Flag Army. The French commander at Yu Oc, Colonel Jacques Duchesne, would later distinguish himself as the conqueror of Madagascar (1895).

zh.s: 玉奥战役发生于1884年11月19日，是中法战争期间法军的一场胜利。法军在玉奥作战，目的是解救被唐景崧的云南军和刘永福的黑旗军围困的宣光法军守军。玉奥法军指挥官雅克·杜申上校后来在1895年征服马达加斯加时声名大噪。

en.s: The Battle of Slivnitsa (Bulgarian: Битка при Сливница, Serbian: Битка на Сливници) was a battle between the Bulgarian Army and the Royal Serbian Army from 17 to 19 November 1885, in the Serbo-Bulgarian War. The Bulgarian victory solidified the unification between the Principality of Bulgaria and Eastern Rumelia.
en.n: Serbo-Bulgarian War: Bulgarian victory in the Battle of Slivnitsa solidifies the unification between the Principality of Bulgaria and Eastern Rumelia.

zh.s: 斯利夫尼察战役又称保加利亚语“Битка при Сливница”、塞尔维亚语“Битка на Сливници”，是保加利亚军队与塞尔维亚王家军队于1885年11月17日至19日在塞保战争期间进行的战斗。保加利亚获胜，巩固了保加利亚公国与东鲁米利亚的统一。

en.s: The Battle of the Cherna bend was a two-month-long battle between the Bulgarian and the Entente armies. The battle took place on the Macedonian front during the First World War Allied Monastir offensive in October and November 1916. After extremely heavy fighting and severe casualties on both sides, the Bulgarians retreated from Bitola on 19 November, taking positions 5 kilometres (3.1 mi) to the north by defeating all the later attacks from there.

en.s: Elections to Spain’s legislature, the Cortes Generales, were held on 19 November 1933 for all 473 seats in the unicameral Cortes of the Second Spanish Republic. Since the previous elections of 1931, a new constitution had been ratified, and the franchise extended to more than six million women. The governing Republican-Socialist coalition had fallen apart, with the Radical Republican Party beginning to support a newly united political right. The right formed an electoral coalition, as was favoured by the new electoral system enacted earlier in the year. The Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (Partido Socialista Obrero Español, or PSOE) won only 59 seats.

en.s: Operation Uranus (19–23 November 1942) was a Soviet strategic operation on the Eastern Front of World War II which led to the encirclement of Axis forces in the vicinity of Stalingrad: the German Sixth Army, the Third and Fourth Romanian armies, and portions of the German Fourth Panzer Army. The Red Army carried out the operation at roughly the midpoint of the five-month long Battle of Stalingrad, aiming to destroy German forces in and around Stalingrad.

en.t: Romanian armies in the Battle of Stalingrad

Underpowered and poorly equipped, these forces were unable to stop the Soviet November offensive (Operation Uranus), which punched through both flanks and left the German 6th Army encircled in Stalingrad.

en.s: General elections were held in Romania on 19 November 1946. The official results gave a victory to the Romanian Communist Party (PCR), its allies inside the Bloc of Democratic Parties (Blocul Partidelor Democrate, BPD), together with its associates, the Hungarian People's Union (UPM or MNSz) and the Democratic Peasants' Party–Lupu. The event marked a decisive step towards the disestablishment of the Romanian monarchy and the proclamation of a Communist regime at the end of the following year. Breaking with the traditional universal male suffrage confirmed by the 1923 Constitution, it was the first national election to feature women's suffrage, and the first to allow active public officials and army personnel the right to vote.

zh.s: 罗马尼亚于1946年11月19日举行大选。官方结果显示，罗马尼亚共产党（PCR）及其在民主党人集团（BPD）中的盟友和合作伙伴匈牙利人民联盟（UPM或MNSz）、民主农民党（卢普派）获胜。此次选举推动了罗马尼亚君主制的瓦解，并为次年年底宣布建立共产主义政权迈出关键一步。这是1923年宪法确立传统男性普选权以来，首次举行女性拥有选举权的全国选举，也是首次允许现职公职人员和军人投票。

en.s: United Express Flight 5925, operated by Great Lakes Airlines with a Beechcraft 1900 twin turboprop, was a regularly scheduled flight from Chicago O'Hare International Airport to Quincy, Illinois, with an intermediate stop in Burlington, Iowa. On November 19, 1996, the aircraft collided on landing at Quincy with another Beechcraft, a private King Air, that was taking off from an intersecting runway.

en.s: STS-87 was a Space Shuttle mission launched from Launch Complex 39B of the Kennedy Space Center on 19 November 1997. It was the 88th flight of the Space Shuttle and the 24th flight of Columbia. The mission goals were to conduct experiments using the United States Microgravity Payload (USMP-4), conduct two EVAs, and deploy the SPARTAN-201 experiment. This mission marked the first time an EVA was performed from Columbia.

zh.s: STS-87航天飞机任务于1997年11月19日从肯尼迪航天中心39B发射台发射升空。这是航天飞机第88次飞行，也是“哥伦比亚”号第24次飞行。任务目标包括使用美国微重力载荷（USMP-4）开展实验、进行两次舱外活动，以及部署SPARTAN-201实验设备。这是“哥伦比亚”号首次进行舱外活动。

en.t: Shenzhou 1: The People's Republic of China launches its first Shenzhou spacecraft
en.s: Shenzhou 1 (simplified Chinese: 神舟一号; traditional Chinese: 神舟一號; pinyin: Shénzhōu Yīhào) was the first uncrewed test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft and the Long March 2F rocket, launched on 19 November 1999. The spacecraft lacked a life-support system but included an emergency escape system. After 14 orbits, the command to begin reentry was sent by the Yuan Wang 3 off the coast of Namibia at 18:49 UTC.

zh.s: 神舟一号是神舟飞船和长征二号F火箭的首次无人试飞，于1999年11月19日发射升空。飞船没有生命保障系统，但配有紧急逃逸系统。飞船绕地球飞行14圈后，远望三号于纳米比亚近海在世界协调时18时49分发出返回指令。

en.s: The 2000 Survivor Series was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the 14th annual Survivor Series and took place on November 19, 2000, at the Ice Palace in Tampa, Florida. en.s: The 107th United States Congress was a meeting of the legislative branch of the United States federal government, composed of the United States Senate and the United States House of Representatives. It met in Washington, D.C., from January 3, 2001, to January 3, 2003, during the final weeks of the Clinton presidency and the first two years of the George W. Bush presidency.
en.n: The Aviation and Transportation Security Act is enacted by the 107th United States Congress in the immediate aftermath of the September 11, 2001 attacks. The Act created the Transportation Security Administration (TSA).

en.t: The Greek oil tanker Prestige split in two and sank off the coast of Galicia after spilling 420 thousand barrels (17.8 million US gallons) of oil, in the worst environmental disaster in Spanish and Portuguese history
en.s: The Prestige oil spill occurred off the coast of Galicia, Spain, in November 2002, caused by the sinking of the 26-year-old, structurally deficient oil tanker MV Prestige, carrying 77,000 tonnes of heavy fuel oil. During a storm, it burst a tank on 13 November, and French, Spanish, and Portuguese governments refused to allow the ship to dock.

zh.t: 希腊油轮“Prestige”号在加利西亚海岸附近断成两截并沉没，泄漏42万桶（1780万美制加仑）石油，成为西班牙和葡萄牙历史上最严重的环境灾难
zh.s: “Prestige”号漏油事件于2002年11月发生在西班牙加利西亚海岸附近，起因是船龄26年、结构状况不佳的“Prestige”号油轮沉没。船上载有77,000吨重燃料油。11月13日，风暴中船体油舱破裂，法国、西班牙和葡萄牙政府拒绝让该船靠岸。

en.s: "Malice at the Palace" was a fight involving players and fans during a National Basketball Association (NBA) game between the Indiana Pacers and the defending champion Detroit Pistons on November 19, 2004, at the Palace in Auburn Hills, Michigan. The Associated Press called it "the most infamous brawl in NBA history". Pistons center Ben Wallace attempted a layup shot during the final minute but was fouled from behind by Pacers small forward Ron Artest.

en.t: K-1 World Grand Prix 2005 in Tokyo Final
en.s: K-1 World Grand Prix 2005 in Tokyo Final was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1. The event was held at the Tokyo Dome in Tokyo, Japan on Saturday, November 19, 2005 in front of 58,213 spectators. It was the thirteenth K-1 World Grand Prix final, involving twelve of the world's best K-1 fighters (four being reservists), with all bouts fought under K-1 Rules (100 kg/156-220 lbs). The tournament qualifiers had almost all qualified via the K-1 World Grand Prix 2005 in Osaka - Final Elimination with the exception of Remy Bonjasky who was the reigning champion.

zh.s: 2005年K-1世界大奖赛东京总决赛是一场由K-1主办的踢拳赛事，于2005年11月19日星期六在日本东京巨蛋举行，现场观众为58,213人。这是第13届K-1世界大奖赛总决赛，共有12名世界顶尖K-1选手参赛，其中4人为候补选手。所有比赛均按K-1规则进行，体重标准为100公斤（156至220磅）。除卫冕冠军雷米·博纳斯基外，其他选手几乎都通过2005年大阪K-1世界大奖赛最终淘汰赛获得参赛资格。

en.s: A general election was held in the Marshall Islands on 19 November 2007. Due to delays in opening the polling stations (while they were meant to open at 7 AM, some did not open until midday and one did not open before 4 PM) polling continued until after midnight. While only 36,000 people were eligible to vote, the large number of postal ballots meant that results were not to be known before 4 December. Early results with 40% of the vote counted indicate a number of government party members may lose their seats, meaning it is possible that the opposition has won the election.

zh.s: 马绍尔群岛于2007年11月19日举行大选。投票站开放延误——原定早上7点开放，但有些直到中午才开放，一个投票站到下午4点后才开放——因此投票持续到午夜以后。虽然只有3.6万人有资格投票，但大量邮寄选票意味着结果要到12月4日才会公布。计票40%后的初步结果显示，执政党多名成员可能失去席位，因此反对党有可能赢得选举。

en.s: The Pike River Mine disaster was a coal mining accident that began on 19 November 2010 in the Pike River Mine, 46 kilometres (29 mi) northeast of Greymouth, in the West Coast Region of New Zealand's South Island. A methane explosion occurred in the mine at approximately 3:44 pm (NZDT, UTC+13). At the time of the explosion 31 miners and contractors were present in the mine. Two miners managed to walk from the mine; they were treated for moderate injuries and released from Greymouth Hospital the next day.

zh.s: 派克河煤矿灾难是一起煤矿事故，始于2010年11月19日，地点在新西兰南岛西海岸大区的派克河煤矿，距格雷茅斯东北46公里（29英里）。当天下午约3时44分（新西兰夏令时，UTC+13）发生甲烷爆炸。爆炸发生时，矿内有31名矿工和承包商。两名矿工自行走出矿井，因中度受伤接受治疗，次日从格雷茅斯医院出院。

en.s: General elections were held in Malaysia on Saturday, 19 November 2022. The prospect of snap elections had been considered high due to the political crisis that had been ongoing since 2020; political instability caused by coalition or party switching among members of Parliament, combined with the fallout of the COVID-19 pandemic, contributed to the resignation of two prime ministers and the collapse of each of their respective coalition governments since the 2018 general elections.

en.s: On November 19–20, 2022, an anti-LGBTQ–motivated mass shooting occurred at Club Q, a gay bar in Colorado Springs, Colorado, United States. Five people were killed, and 25 others were injured, 19 of them by gunfire. The shooter, 22-year-old Anderson Lee Aldrich, was also injured while being restrained, and was taken to a local hospital. Aldrich was then charged and remanded in custody.

en.s: The 2023 Cricket World Cup Final was a One Day International cricket match played at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad, on 19 November 2023 to determine the winner of the 2023 Cricket World Cup. It was played between host nation India and Australia. It was the first time that Ahmedabad hosted a Cricket World Cup final. It was the second time that India and Australia played a World Cup final against each other, after the 2003 final. In the final, Australia defeated India to win a record-extending sixth World Cup title.
